title: AI animated archival photographs for a historical film
summary: Giovanni Abitante used generative video to animate archival photographs for I Am an American; educational effects have not been measured.
source_collection: University of Texas AI Opportunity Inventory
account: Giovanni Abitante used generative video to animate Dorothea Lange’s photographs and reconstruct scenes for I Am an American, a short film about the wartime incarceration of Japanese Americans. In a July 2025 festival interview, he described AI as a production technique within a project that depended on archival research and writing. PerSo’s program lists the film and its recorded testimony. The evidence establishes a completed creative work and public exhibition, not a measured improvement in historical understanding or audience engagement.
purpose: The filmmaker used AI to create moving images from historical photographs for a completed film.
system: Generative video tools used in I Am an American
